reason: The candidate call attempts to remove items from a pending order (item_ids has 3 entries, new_item_ids is empty). Policy allows modifying a pending order's items only by exchanging each item for a different item of the same product type ('each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option'); it does not support deleting items outright, and the tool schema requires new_item_ids to match item_ids position-for-position. Passing an empty new_item_ids array for 3 items to be 'removed' is not a supported operation and mismatches the required parameter structure. Additionally, the agent had not yet quoted the confirmed refund total or completed the required confirmation of full action details (refund amount, payment method) before calling the mutating tool.
policy_references: For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option. There cannot be any change of product types
This action can only be called once, and will change the order status to 'pending (items modifed)'... you must confirm all the details are correct and be cautious before taking this action
Each new item id should match the item id in the same position and be of the same product.
